title: PSAP agent turn output
description: Typed output contract every PSAP agent emits per turn. The voice-facing agents stream caller-facing text to ElevenLabs separately; this schema describes the structured verification record that sits alongside the streamed text and is consumed by the session coordinator, safety monitor, and rubric grader.

agent.description: Agent identifier; must match a registered agent in agents/manifest.yaml

turn_id.description: Monotonic turn identifier within the session; uniquely identifies this turn across the 20-agent topology

action.description: Primary action the agent is taking this turn. speak: caller-facing utterance streamed to ElevenLabs. defer: agent declines to act, passes to coordinator. refuse: agent refuses on safety / scope grounds; includes reason + alternative. escalate: surface to safety-monitor for interrupt decision. handoff: transfer control to named next-phase agent. end: close the session.

content.description: Caller-facing text — REQUIRED when action=speak, MUST be null otherwise. Streamed to ElevenLabs as SSE content chunks; must contain no JSON, no XML, no code blocks, no references to other turns by ID. Prose only.

rationale.description: Internal reasoning; never spoken. Must cite inputs — which prior turns, which knowledge-pack sections drove this decision.

cites.description: Evidence anchors. turn:<turn_id> references prior conversation. kb:<path>#<section> references the tracked knowledge pack (docs/dispatch-protocol-v0.1.md, docs/aha-bls-2025-pdi.md, etc.). clinical:<guideline>-<section> references a specific clinical guideline section.

confidence.description: Agent's self-reported confidence in this turn's action + content. 0.0 = must-defer territory; 1.0 = ironclad.

confidence_basis.description: How confidence was derived. citation = cited evidence supports it directly. inference = reasoning from cited evidence. default = no citation, using training-grade knowledge. uncertain = low confidence, calling this out.

next_phase.description: Suggested next phase for the session coordinator. May be overridden by safety-monitor or ohca-detector signals.

alerts.description: Flags fired to the session coordinator + safety-monitor. Each alert routes per the topology in docs/agents/topology.md.

refuse.description: Present when action=refuse. Describes the refusal reason + the alternative offered to the caller.

all_passed.description: Shorthand: are all checks in `checks` passed? If false, action MUST be 'defer' or 'refuse' or 'escalate'.

self_verify.description: Agent's self-verification record, checked by the coordinator before the turn's content streams to the caller. This is the frontier-lab gate: nothing the caller hears bypasses this record.

debug.description: Optional developer-only context; stripped from public logs. Not caller-facing. Not guaranteed to be stable.
